votes outrun the chainsaw's roar

Rails did what rails do
until this morning in Spain—
thirty empty seats

gathering toward the wide drain

still holds: a judge shuts the line
no fraud flows upstream

and the flow stays whole

the last convoy leaves Iraq

on death row, then someone signed
and let her walk free

a valve the White House shut tight

old pipes find daylight

could ever carry

old pipes, new water

one American walks free
